battlefield.name: Grizzly Bears
battlefield.contextNotes: one +1/+1 counter; Giant Growth resolved on it this turn

question: If Player 2's Turn to Frog resolves, what are my Grizzly Bears' power and toughness for the rest of the turn?

expected.shortAnswer: 5/5: the 1/1 base is set first, then +3/+3 and +1/+1 apply.
expected.answer: Your Grizzly Bears will be a 5/5 blue Frog with no abilities. Turn to Frog sets base power and toughness to 1/1 in layer 7b (613.4b); Giant Growth's +3/+3 and the +1/+1 counter are modifications, applied in layer 7c (613.4c) after 7b regardless of timing. 1/1 + 3/3 + 1/1 = 5/5.

whyHard: Setting base power and toughness (7b) always applies before modifiers and counters (7c), so the order the spells were cast in does not matter.
